newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas ready to cut ads, travel role-paper.
newsitem.headline: Havas ready to cut ads, travel role-paper.

text.p: French media group Havas is ready to reduce its role in travel and advertising following a deal with Generale des Eaux to strengthen its media activities such as television, chairman Pierre Dauzier told Les Echos.

"For us, Havas Advertising is an observation post for the evolution of consumer trends. If Alain de Pouzilhac (head of the advertsing unit) comes with a proposal for an operation which would reinforce his international potential, I am ready to let the Havas stake go down to 20 percent from 37 percent now," Dauzier told the newspaper in an interview.

He said that if Havas did not have the financial means to develop its audiovisual, publishing and travel activities at the same time, he would ask Havas Voyages chairman Christophe Charpentier to make proposals "which preserve the human and financial interests of Havas Voyages."
